scope: Read-only preparation for the next VIP/regular-customer stage. Source paths refer to the pinned Hospitality snapshot and current own modules.
acceptedFacts: Bed search is delayed by 4 game ticks per silver before the first attempt.
A failed search sets lastBedCheckTick to now+500, so a later attempt also includes the purse-dependent delay.
Native personal visit score differs from the group average used for gifts and goodwill.
Dossier identity and blacklist provide extension points; no VIP state is yet implemented.
corrections: A rejected visitor may already be spawned and walks off; map entry is not prevented.
Current accepted visits, registered clinical guests and recovered-on-map groups are exempted by existing admission filtering.
Real seconds depend on simulation speed; use game ticks or in-game hours.
The native wallet capacity branch must be followed before claiming excess money drops on the ground.
When spaceFor>0 the purse is clamped to spaceFor; the excess is not dropped. The floor fallback is only the zero-space branch.
nextStageConstraints: No story incidents in this stage.
Do not change faction availability assumptions for future mod factions.
VIP wealth is a physical budget, not automatic income.
